string.text: Run full GC at level changes and loads
Frees Lua heap garbage before the next level loads. Only affects Lua memory, not engine memory.
Also run GC periodically during gameplay
A full GC can cause a brief hitch. Lower the frequency if you notice stutter.
Log Lua heap size to the game log
Writes [ram_trim] lines to the log so you can see how much memory was freed.
